kjv: This is my blood of the new testament
mine: This is My blood of the covenant
note: TR adds "kaines" ("new") from Luke/Paul; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, C, L. KJV's "testament" for diatheke also obscures the covenant allusion (Exod 24:8).

kjv: Take, eat: this is my body
note: TR adds "phagete" ("eat") from Matt 26:26; absent from Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, C, D.
